title: Business Office Standard — The Open Balance of an Independent Living Account and Payments Toward the Coming Month
content:
Because a payment is applied to the oldest outstanding charge first, the open balance of an Independent Living Residency Agreement account is settled before the coming month.

## Standard

**The open balance.** The open balance is every monthly fee, community fee, service fee and late fee charge, every returned payment and every credit balance refund on the residency ledger, less every payment and every credit on it.

**Advance amount by open balance.**

| Open balance of the account | Advance amount for the coming month |
|---|---|
| Owed (above zero) | The open balance plus the coming month's statement |
| A credit (below zero) | The credit carries forward: the coming month's statement less that credit, never below zero |
| Zero | The coming month's statement alone |

**Late fee entries.** The advance amount is worked out only after the ledger carries a late fee entry for the billing period of the latest monthly fee charge whenever that period's grace period has ended with a past-due amount at or above the minimum that draws a late fee.

Restated in the same terms: where the grace period of the billing period of the latest monthly fee charge has ended with a past-due amount at or above the minimum that draws a late fee, the advance amount is worked out only once the ledger carries a late fee entry for that billing period.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical ledger figures)

| Ledger | Open balance | Coming month's statement | Advance amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Charges 19,850.00; returned payment 4,000.00; payments 18,000.00; credits 350.00 | 5,500.00 owed | 4,200.00 | 9,700.00 |
| Charges 12,000.00; payments 12,600.00; credits 0.00 | 600.00 credit | 4,200.00 | 3,600.00 |
| Charges 8,000.00; payments 12,500.00 | 4,500.00 credit | 4,200.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) |
| Charges 9,000.00; payments 8,800.00; credits 200.00 | Zero | 4,200.00 | 4,200.00 |

In the first row, the charges and the returned payment total 23,850.00, and the payments and credits total 18,350.00; the difference, 5,500.00, is owed.
